decisions.why: 0.15.2 first scaffolds config templates on install; 0.10.0 verified missing the config; skills render tokens since 0.12.17
decisions.rejected: >=0.12.17 (config not scaffolded) and >=1.0.4 (excludes working versions without evidence)

decisions.decision: smoke-minimum reads the floor from the manifest >= clause
decisions.why: tests whatever the manifest claims, no second copy to drift; matches assert-install.sh convention

decisions.decision: Separate job named Install smoke test (minimum spec-kit), not a matrix
decisions.why: a matrix renames runs after matrix values, so the required check Install smoke test would stop reporting and block merges

decisions.decision: README documents only --from plus a team-controlled catalog; never --install-allowed on community
decisions.why: spec-kit calls that flag the vetting boundary and catalog add replaces the built-in catalog list, dropping default
decisions.rejected: FR-007/FR-008 as first written (flip community with a trust warning)

decisions.decision: assert-install.sh: single-integer count, zero files fails, readable FAIL without extensions.yml
decisions.why: an aborted install produced a [ error, a PASS at 0 files and a Python traceback
decisions.rejected: || true, which still leaves an empty count when the log is missing

decisions.decision: Constitution 1.2.0 with rationale; hand-edit plan template as a justified violation

A spec-kit integration upgrade (copilot --skills) ran outside this step at 15:08 local and left 119 staged changes plus unstaged template overwrites on this branch; not part of feature 006 and must not be swept into its commits

plan.summary: Plan for catalog readiness: floor >=0.15.2 everywhere, manifest category/effect, --from-only install docs, status --, CI pin v1.2.0 plus a manifest-derived minimum job, robust install assertions
plan.key_finding: spec-kit advises against flipping the community catalog to install_allowed and catalog add replaces the built-in catalog list, so the spec was clarified to drop that route

tasks.summary: 18 tasks: a Setup gate (toolchain change lands first), 1 foundational manifest task, 5 story phases with disjoint files (US1 README, US2 constitution and template, US3 verify, US4 status, US5 CI with fail-first seeds), Polish (CHANGELOG and validation)

approach: Edit in place across the manifest, README, status command, constitution, plan template, validate.yml and assert-install.sh. The floor moves to >=0.15.2 in every restatement; CI pins v1.2.0 and adds a job that installs the floor read from the manifest; the README leads with --from and never suggests flipping the community catalog.
